import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    g = params[0]*np.log(1+params[1]*t)
    return g*(1 + params[2]*P) - params[3]*P**2 + params[4]*P

import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    I = params[0]*(1-np.exp(-params[1]*t))
    return I + (params[2]+params[3]*np.sqrt(t))*P + params[4]*P**2 + params[5]*P**2*np.sqrt(t) + params[6]*t*P
